high.title: Over 16.3 Trillion VND in Bonds Flow into Enterprises in March
high.summary: According to Vietnam Bond Market Association (VBMA) data compiled from Hanoi Stock Exchange (HNX) and State Securities Commission (SSC), as of March 31, 2026, the market recorded 3 private placements worth 11.616 trillion VND and 2 public offerings valued at 4.695 trillion VND. For Q1 2026, total private placement value reached 11.885 trillion VND while public offerings reached 12.917 trillion VND. March alone accounted for about 2/3 of total issuance from the beginning of the year, showing capital flows are trending back to the bond channel. Notable issuances included EVF's 450 billion VND private placement with 8.5% fixed interest rate and 8-year maturity, and Marina Center's massive 10.195 trillion VND private placement. This surge in corporate bond issuance indicates improving market liquidity and investor appetite for fixed-income securities, which could influence government bond yields and overall interest rate environment in Vietnam.

high.title: US CPI March Unexpectedly Surges to 4-Year High: Are Hopes for Early Fed Rate Cuts Fading?
high.summary: US CPI surged 0.9% in March, the strongest increase since June 2022 during the Russia-Ukraine conflict peak. Year-over-year, CPI rose 3.3%, significantly higher than February's 2.4%. This inflation spike coincides with strong job market recovery, though experts worry prolonged Middle East conflicts could hurt labor markets. Rising tensions between US-Israel and Iran have pushed global oil prices up over 30%, with US retail gasoline exceeding $4/gallon for the first time in 3+ years. This development has major implications for Vietnamese markets as higher US rates could strengthen the USD against VND, potentially pressuring SBV to adjust policy rates. Vietnamese bond investors should monitor Fed policy shifts closely as they directly impact capital flows and local interest rate expectations.

medium.title: Baoviet Group Benefits Significantly from Rising Deposit Rates with Over 146 Trillion VND in Bank Deposits
medium.summary: Baoviet Group's audited financial report shows total held-to-maturity financial investments reached 259.477 trillion VND by end-2025, up from 225.452 trillion VND previously. Bank deposits comprise the largest portion with nearly 119.624 trillion VND in short-term deposits and over 26.951 trillion VND in long-term deposits, totaling approximately 146.5 trillion VND. These VND deposits have maturities from 3 months to under 1 year with maximum interest rates up to 9%/year, indicating the insurance giant benefits significantly from rising deposit rates.

medium.title: Kafi Securities Has New Chairman, Plans to Double Profits and IPO Ambitions
medium.summary: Kafi Securities appointed Nguyen Viet Cuong as new Chairman on April 10. The leadership restructuring comes as Kafi reported strong 2025 results with revenue reaching 2.842 trillion VND (up 197% YoY) and pre-tax profit of 458 trillion VND (up 78%). Total assets reached 26 trillion VND by end-2025. The management changes position the company for improved governance standards ahead of potential stock market listing plans.

medium.title: VPBankS Independent Board Member Resigns
medium.summary: VPBank Securities (VPX) announced the resignation of independent board member Nguyen Quang Trung due to personal reasons. This follows the earlier resignation of Vu Huu Dien in March. VPBankS' 2026 AGM is scheduled for April 20 in Hanoi, with the board proposing 2026 business plans targeting total revenue of 11.074 trillion VND.

medium.title: Positive Signals Emerge: How Will Securities Market Perform Next Week?
medium.summary: Experts forecast VN-Index will fluctuate around 1,750 points next week. Foreign investors returned to net buying over 842 billion VND on April 10 after selling over 2 trillion VND in the previous session. The cautious optimism suggests careful capital deployment should focus on sectors with strong Q1 results like securities, steel, and banking.
